rows.grounds: present atmanepada third singular of root jan

items.question: What arises when the hidden true nature is known?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature causes all-knowingness.
items.inference: All-knowingness is the fruit of knowing the hidden true nature.
uncertainties: taṃ refers to the previously mentioned object; gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ is the accusative object of jñātvā.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
